description: Google has confirmed a price increase for the Pixel 11 Pro, while also revealing dedicated efforts to enhance Android's RAM efficiency.

sections.heading: Price Increase
paragraphs: Google has confirmed a price increase for its Pixel 11 Pro, as reported by GSMArena.com. This price hike is part of a broader trend affecting the entire Pixel lineup.

sections.heading: RAM Efficiency
paragraphs: In addition to the price increase, Google has revealed dedicated efforts to make Android more RAM-efficient, according to 9to5Google. This initiative aims to enhance the performance and accessibility of Google's devices.

sections.heading: Accessibility and Efficiency
paragraphs: The Times of India reports that Google's dedicated efforts also focus on making phones more accessible and efficient, which aligns with the company's commitment to improving user experience.

faq.q: What has Google confirmed about the Pixel 11 Pro?

faq.q: What is Google doing to improve Android?
faq.a: Google has revealed dedicated efforts to make Android more RAM-efficient, as reported by 9to5Google.

faq.q: How does Google's efforts impact users?
faq.a: Google's efforts aim to make phones more accessible and efficient, which can enhance the user experience, as mentioned by The Times of India.
